name: Devils Tower
source: USGS Wyoming FEMA East lidar (NAVD88 metres). USGS 3DEP public-domain lidar, Entwine Point Tiles: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/WY_FEMA_East_B3_2019/ept.json
facts: Devils Tower was the very first national monument in the United States. It rises about 867 feet, or 264 metres, above the river below.
Its sides are made of giant stone columns, most with five or six sides, that formed when hot melted rock slowly cooled underground.
axes: +X east, +Y up, +Z south; metres = int16 * scale; y = 0 is the water level
order: random (the first N points are an even subsample)
